vulnerability_type: Loss of funds / permanently locked collateral (position-note vs PositionPDA decoupling)
line_range: 1031-1419, 1424-1798 (change-note append at 1265-1274 and 1625-1634); PDA creators at open_position:1329-1336 and merge_positions:1730-1737
description: Position value is held in ZK notes in the position Merkle tree, but a note can only ever be *spent* (closed/merged) if a matching PositionPDA exists at seeds [b"position_pda_v1", poseidon(note_secret)]. A PositionPDA is created in exactly two places: open_position (for the freshly opened position note) and merge_positions (for the single merged output note). The swap circuit used by close_position / close_position_to_sol emits TWO output commitments: output_commitment_1 = the swapped-out proceeds note (USDC/SOL, deposited into a note-based pool where it is freely spendable) and output_commitment_0 = a *position change note* re-inserted into the position tree (append_and_emit at positions.rs:1265 and :1625). On a PARTIAL close (swap_amount < full note value) this change note carries the remaining position value, yet NO PositionPDA is created for it and the spent position's PDA is closed (close = relayer). Because close_position/close_position_to_sol/merge_positions all require an already-initialized PositionPDA (Anchor `bump = position_pda.bump`, non-init) keyed by the note secret, the orphaned change note can never be closed or merged again. The remaining collateral in the shared per-mint position vault becomes permanently unspendable.
attack_scenario: A user (or relayer acting for a user) opens a position note worth V of a meme token (PositionPDA_A created, V meme in the shared position vault). They later submit close_position with swap_amount = V/2 (a valid partial close the swap circuit supports: change note = V - swap_amount). The tx succeeds: note A is nullified, PDA_A is closed to the relayer, V/2 meme is swapped out to a spendable USDC/SOL note, and a change note worth V/2 is appended to the position tree. That change note has a fresh secret => a fresh position_pda_key for which no account was ever `init`ed. Any subsequent close_position/close_position_to_sol/merge_positions for it fails at the Accounts stage (`seeds ... bump = position_pda.bump` on a non-existent account), so the V/2 of vault collateral is stranded forever.
impact: Permanent loss of access to the residual collateral of any partially-closed position. No attacker profit (funds are locked, not stolen), and no cross-user theft, but user funds backing an orphaned change note are unrecoverable. Severity is bounded by whether the relayer/client ever issues partial closes; the circuit and on-chain code both permit them, so the failure mode is reachable.
recommendation: Either (a) forbid partial closes explicitly (require swap_amount equals the full note value / require the change note to be a canonical zero-value note), or (b) create a PositionPDA for the change note inside close_position/close_position_to_sol (init a new_position_pda keyed by the change note secret, mirroring merge_positions' new_position_pda), so the remaining position value stays spendable. If partial closes are intentionally unsupported, document and enforce it on-chain rather than relying on client behavior.
poc_outline: 1. init_position_pool + fund a meme mint vault via open_position, producing PositionPDA_A (balance V) and V meme in position_vault_ata. 2. Build a SwapProof for a partial close: input note A (value V), swap_amount = V/2, output_commitment_0 = change note (value V/2, new secret S'), output_commitment_1 = USDC/SOL proceeds note. 3. Call close_position: assert it succeeds, PDA_A is closed, change note appended to position tree. 4. Attempt close_position (or merge_positions) for note S': derive position_pda_key = poseidon(S'); show the required PositionPDA account does not exist and cannot be created by any instruction => tx fails at account resolution. 5. Conclude the V/2 vault collateral is unspendable.
